name: Gartner, Inc.
blurb: Gartner, Inc. provides actionable business and technology insights to organizations worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Research (subscription-based access to published content, data, and expert networks), Conferences (executive and team events), and Consulting (advisory services). With a market cap of approximately $10.56 billion and over 20,000 employees, Gartner is a leading provider of IT research and advisory services.
recent: As of May 7, 2026, Gartner's stock closed at $157.78, up 4.46% on the day, with a 52-week range of $139.18 to $451.73. The company reported earnings on May 5, 2026, with revenue of $6.47 billion (up 2.3% year-over-year) and net income of $740.64 million (down 40.9%). Analysts have a Hold rating with a price target of $174.75.
